sample_unit: genetic counselors and genetic counseling students surveyed

links.outcome: Proportion of genetic counselors who received AI training
links.effect: 16/195 (8.2%) received AI training; limited training identified as a barrier to adoption of chatbots in genetic counseling.
links.quote: Limited AI training was identified as a barrier to adoption (16/195; 8.2% received training), highlighting a need for structured education on AI applications in genetic counseling.

screen.reason: Survey of genetic counselors and students regarding their current real-world clinical use, perceptions, and barriers concerning AI chatbots in practice.
